title: `AssignmentSource.queued` default evaluated at import time
description: `timezone.now()` is evaluated once when the module imports, not per instance. Every AssignmentSource carries the identical process-start timestamp instead of the actual queueing time. Should use `field(default_factory=timezone.now)`.

title: `assignment_source` parameter in `sync_status_outbound` unreachable
description: Parameter added to abstract signature but never passed by the only caller. Implementations inconsistent—some use **kwargs (safe), example integration lacks **kwargs and would raise TypeError if called.
